senses.gloss:
वृणान, अस्, आ, अम्, choosing, preferring; suppli-
cating, adoring.

वृण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, choosing, electing, preferring
(especially as a husband or wife).
वृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, choosing, selecting, &c.

वृण् वृण्, cl. 8. P. A. वृणोति, वृणुते,
to consume, eat; cl. 6. P. वृणति, to
please, gratify, exhilarate.
